parsed.explanation: No trans-specific crime, border, facility or custody restriction is documented, and 2016 anti-discrimination and some provincial hate-crime enhancements exist on paper. However severity if outed is driven by documented hostility and state failure: 84% opposed same-sex marriage (2017), 48% would try to 'cure' a gay child (2015), a 2008 festival stormed, 2014 Pride organisers attacked despite police coordination with a court finding authorities failed to protect, and in 2023 police cancelled LGBTI screenings after which activists were chased and attacked. The 2024 monitor reports a worsening trend. No prosecutions under hate-crime provisions are documented, so recourse is not shown to operate; resident LGR/medical requirements are climate only. This is tier-3 hostility with thin recourse, not acceptance with working protection.
